metas.name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
metas.description: An excellent ensemble workplace comedy with a similar wholesome-yet-wacky energy to Scrubs and New Girl.

metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: A highly uplifting and feel-good mockumentary that matches the optimistic spirit of Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Bob's Burgers
metas.description: A cozy and hilarious family animation that fans of The Simpsons and King of the Hill will find very comforting.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: This cult-classic British sitcom about tech support captures the nerdy humor of Silicon Valley with a sitcom format.

metas.name: Arrested Development
metas.description: A brilliant, fast-paced comedy with complex running gags that appeal to fans of Community's meta-humor.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A hilarious and quirky mockumentary about vampires that fits the supernatural-comedy niche of The Good Place.

metas.name: Schitt's Creek
metas.description: A heartwarming and funny 'fish out of water' story that provides the same emotional growth seen in Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Psych
metas.description: A lighthearted detective show full of pop-culture references and fun adventures, perfect for fans of Dirk Gently.

metas.name: Taskmaster
metas.description: A low-stakes, incredibly funny British reality competition that provides great background viewing similar to Gogglebox.

metas.name: 30 Rock
metas.description: A high-energy, joke-dense comedy that matches the fast pacing and satirical edge of Silicon Valley and Community.

metas.name: Veep
metas.description: A sharp, fast-talking political satire that shares the cynical and brilliant wit found in Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Flight of the Conchords
metas.description: A dry, musical, and awkward comedy that resonates with the unique comedic sensibilities of Peep Show.

metas.name: Superstore
metas.description: A very easy-to-watch workplace sitcom with a diverse cast, serving as great background comfort like New Girl.

metas.name: Abbott Elementary
metas.description: A modern, wholesome workplace comedy that is consistently funny and uplifting, much like Ted Lasso.

metas.name: Atlanta
metas.description: A stylistically bold and surreal comedy-drama that fans of Master of None's unique storytelling will appreciate.

metas.name: Cowboy Bebop
metas.description: A classic sci-fi adventure anime with a cool atmosphere and great music, matching the fun spirit of One Piece.

metas.name: Spy x Family
metas.description: A charming and funny animation about a makeshift family, blending action and wholesome comedy perfectly.

metas.name: Mob Psycho 100
metas.description: Created by the author of One-Punch Man, this offers incredible action and a very heart-centered, funny story.

metas.name: Curb Your Enthusiasm
metas.description: Larry David's masterpiece of social awkwardness and escalation is a must-watch for It's Always Sunny fans.

metas.name: The Office
metas.description: The quintessential background comfort show. If you enjoyed the ensemble dynamics of New Girl and Scrubs, this is a staple.

metas.name: Fleabag
metas.description: A sharp, fourth-wall-breaking British comedy that matches the internal monologue feel of Peep Show.

metas.name: Ghosts
metas.description: A gentle and funny British sitcom about a couple living in a house full of ghosts from different eras.

metas.name: The Orville
metas.description: A sci-fi comedy that balances humor with genuine adventure, making it a great live-action counterpart to Futurama.

metas.name: Party Down
metas.description: A cult-classic comedy about catering workers that features a cynical but hilarious outlook similar to Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Nathan For You
metas.description: A brilliant, awkward, and experimental comedy that pushes boundaries, appealing to fans of Always Sunny's chaos.

metas.name: Star Trek: Lower Decks
metas.description: An animated sci-fi comedy that celebrates the genre while being hilariously irreverent, similar to Rick and Morty.

metas.name: Detectorists
metas.description: A beautiful, slow, and quiet British comedy that offers ultimate relaxation and comfort.

metas.name: Our Flag Means Death
metas.description: A fun and romantic pirate adventure that captures the lighthearted action energy of One Piece.

metas.name: Misfits
metas.description: A gritty but very funny British show about teenagers with superpowers, matching the tone of Brassic.

metas.name: Derry Girls
metas.description: A high-energy and hilarious look at teenage life in 1990s Northern Ireland, full of heart and wit.

metas.name: Shrinking
metas.description: From the creators of Ted Lasso, this show deals with grief through a very funny and heartwarming lens.

metas.name: Solar Opposites
metas.description: Created by the co-creator of Rick and Morty, this show delivers the same brand of chaotic sci-fi animation.

metas.name: The Great British Bake Off
metas.description: The ultimate low-stress, feel-good reality show that is perfect for background viewing.

metas.name: Reservation Dogs
metas.description: A unique, funny, and touching coming-of-age story that matches the grounded yet creative feel of Master of None.

metas.name: Dave
metas.description: A meta-comedy about an aspiring rapper that blends awkward humor with surreal sequences, similar to Atlanta.

metas.name: Black Books
metas.description: A cynical and surreal British sitcom set in a bookstore, perfect for fans of the dry humor in Peep Show.

metas.name: Toast of London
metas.description: Matt Berry stars as an eccentric actor in this surreal British comedy that fans of quirky humor will love.

metas.name: Gravity Falls
metas.description: While for all ages, its smart mystery and humor make it a great comfort watch for fans of Futurama and The Simpsons.

metas.name: Hunter x Hunter
metas.description: A top-tier action-adventure anime with a great sense of wonder and world-building like One Piece.

metas.name: Letterkenny
metas.description: A fast-paced, wordplay-heavy Canadian comedy that focuses on the eccentricities of small-town life.
